name: Asshur
overview: Asshur is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Dedan, as recorded in Genesis 25:3. Beyond this paternal connection, Scripture does not provide additional details about his tribe or other distinguishing attributes. His mention is brief, serving primarily to establish genealogical lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Asshur' appears once in the biblical text without a provided meaning or special title. Therefore, it is recognized simply as a proper name without further revealed significance in the Scripture reference given.
familyAndRelationships: Asshur is explicitly identified as the son of Dedan according to Genesis 25:3. No other family relationships or descendants are recorded in the biblical text for Asshur beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Asshur's significance in the biblical narrative lies chiefly in his role within the genealogical record, connecting him to the descendants of Dedan. This lineage contributes to the broader understanding of family lines and nations descending from Abraham's descendants. Though not elaborated upon, such genealogies help trace God's providential unfolding of history.
